info.title: MedDesk API
info.description: MedDesk MVP: identity and administration, Knowledge Base/private media, support tickets, database-derived staff analytics, administrator audit browsing and versioned clinic settings. Same-origin opaque sessions, Origin/CSRF mutation checks, current-role authorization and transactional audits. Staff ticket exports provide localized XLSX management reports and UTF-8 CSV for every selected result, with optional creation-date filters.

Open=NEW/IN_PROGRESS/WAITING_FOR_USER; resolved=RESOLVED/CLOSED; closed is a subset. Mean resolution hours uses original creation to current resolved_at for selected currently resolved/closed tickets; an empty measurement stays blank.

409.description: export_limit: selection exceeds 5000 tickets, 20 MiB serialized output or the 20 MiB uncompressed worksheet budget; narrow the dates or filters. No partial attachment is returned.

200.description: Complete filtered selection in one read-only repeatable-read snapshot; safe attachment filename and private/no-store response. CSV has a UTF-8 BOM, localized headers and formula-safe text. XLSX adds clinic, period, applied filters, current status totals and mean resolution hours above typed ticket rows. Internal comments, media, credentials and email addresses are excluded.

CookieSession.name: meddesk_session
CookieSession.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie, Secure in production. A second HttpOnly meddesk_csrf cookie and X-CSRF-Token protect mutations.

department_id.description: Clinic department UUID; empty for a school-only identity.

account_scope.description: Authentication always includes scope; school accounts are denied all clinic resources regardless of role.

csrf_token.description: Keep in memory and send as X-CSRF-Token on authenticated mutations.

password.description: 12 to 72 UTF-8 bytes; do not trim passwords.
12 to 72 UTF-8 bytes; do not trim passwords.
12 to 72 UTF-8 bytes; do not trim passwords.

translation_ru.description: Optional complete Russian translation. Omission on update preserves the existing translation. Original fields contain Kazakh content.
Optional complete Russian translation. Omission on update preserves the existing translation. Original fields contain Kazakh content.

CreateArticle.description: Strict JSON object bounded to 64 KiB. Plain text steps/content; media must have the correct purpose and be owned by the actor, already attached to this article, or selected by an administrator. Publishing requires an active category.

translation_ru.description: Optional complete Russian translation. Omission on update preserves the existing translation. Original fields contain Kazakh content.

UpdateArticle.description: Full replacement of editable fields with the version used to initialize the editing form. Stale versions return version_conflict (409) and must not overwrite newer content.

priority.description: Omitted priority uses the current configured default within the ticket creation transaction.

TicketArticleInput.description: Strict JSON bounded to 64 KiB. Staff submit reviewed plain-text content for a resolved/closed ticket. Creates a single unpublished draft and ticket link in one audited transaction; no ticket screenshots are copied automatically.

reporting_timezone.description: IANA timezone; deployment secrets and authentication configuration are not application settings.

ReportingPeriod.description: Inclusive local calendar dates, at most 366 days. start_at inclusive/end_at exclusive UTC instants, preserving daylight-saving calendar boundaries. Defaults to last30 local days in configured reporting timezone.

AnalyticsSummary.description: Ticket creation cohort with current statuses; resolved includes closed. Average spans original creation to current resolved_at for currently resolved/closed tickets; reopened open tickets excluded. Self-service is helpful/all completed immutable feedback attempts, null without attempts. Assignee filters affect tickets only; feedback/views use current user department and current article category.

AnalyticsTrend.description: One row per local calendar day. Tickets grouped by creation date; resolved is current cohort state, not a resolution-event count.

AnalyticsReport.description: Read-only repeatable-read PostgreSQL snapshot. common_issues ranks ticket category buckets; popular articles use separately aggregated actual period views and feedback to avoid count multiplication.

metadata.description: Allowlisted and type-validated safe identifiers, enums, counters and booleans. Arbitrary strings, nested secrets, request content and credentials are removed on reads.

public_reply.description: Employee-visible answer; resolution remains private to owner.

requester_id.description: School requester, null for legacy/manual owner requests.

password.description: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes, hashed using existing bcrypt policy; never returned or logged.
12–72 UTF-8 bytes, hashed using existing bcrypt policy; never returned or logged.

SchoolMemberUpdate.description: Email, role, account scope and department cannot be changed. Password resets and deactivation revoke sessions atomically. Omit password to preserve it.

SchoolEmployeeRequestInput.description: Server binds requester identity. Device IDs, requester identity, status and private resolution are rejected as unknown fields.
